subject: Security compliance discovery - FinCo / Redwood (SOC 2, GDPR, ISO roadmap)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: James Ellis <j.ellis@finco.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Security compliance discovery - FinCo / Redwood (SOC 2, GDPR, ISO roadmap)

Hi James —

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and recommended next steps so we have a shared view: 

Summary of what we covered
- Current state: FinCo collects PII and financial data for EU and US customers. You mentioned a security review for new vendors.
- SOC 2: Redwood has SOC 2 Type II in progress; our audit period is Q3-Q4 2026 with an expected report delivery in early Q1 2027. I attached a one-page SOC2 scope summary (SOC2_report_stub.pdf) to give you the high-level controls we cover today.
- GDPR: We support Processor agreements (DPA) and standard SCCs; we can provide a data processing addendum.
- HIPAA: You indicated PHI is not in scope for the current integration; happy to re-evaluate if that changes.

Ask / next steps
1) Please share FinCo's vendor security questionnaire so we can populate it and return by EOD Thu (I've attached a vendor questionnaire template to speed this up).
2) Rishi (cc'd) will lead a 30-min compliance roadmap call to review certifications (ISO 27001, SOC scope expansion, and exploratory FedRAMP fit). Can you confirm availability next week?
3) Neha (cc'd) will coordinate docs: DPA, SOC artifact list, encryption details.

Attachments: Vendor_Security_Questionnaire_Template.xlsx, SOC2_report_stub.pdf

If helpful I can also share our SOC2 control matrix and past penetration test summary on the roadmap call.

Best,

--
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: James Ellis <j.ellis@finco.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@finco.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 09:22:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Security compliance discovery - FinCo / Redwood (SOC 2, GDPR, ISO roadmap)

Marissa,

Thanks for the clear recap — appreciated. I attached our standard vendor security questionnaire (FinCo_Security_Questionnaire_v1.xlsx). A few quick answers and clarifications from our side: 

- SOC 2 timeline: we generally require a Type II report but can accept a SOC 2 Type II in progress if there's a remediation plan and timeline. We'll need ETA on Redwood's final report (you mentioned early Q1 2027).
- GDPR: we'll need a DPA and confirmation about subprocessors (can you provide a current subprocessor list/staging?).
- ISO 27001 / FedRAMP: Long-term, our compliance team prefers vendors with ISO 27001; FedRAMP is a future requirement for some workloads but not immediate.

Can Rishi/Neha provide the following by EOD Thu so we can move through procurement?
1) Completed questionnaire (we can iterate)
2) DPA template (or a link to Redwood's standard DPA)
3) High-level roadmap doc showing SOC2 completion, ISO evaluation plan, and whether Redwood intends to pursue FedRAMP (even a timeline is helpful)

I'll loop in procurement for contract timing once we have the questionnaire and DPA. Thanks — looking forward to the roadmap call.

Best,
James Ellis
Director, Security & Risk | FinCo
j.ellis@finco.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: James Ellis <j.ellis@finco.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Procurement <procurement@finco.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security compliance discovery - FinCo / Redwood (SOC 2, GDPR, ISO roadmap)

James —

Great, thanks for the questionnaire. Next steps from our side: 

- Neha will take the questionnaire first pass and return a completed copy by Thu EOD (14 Aug). Neha — can you confirm?
- Rishi will run a 30-min roadmap call to walk through SOC 2 status, ISO 27001 plans, and a FedRAMP fit/gap. Proposed times: Mon 17 Aug 10:00-10:30 PT or Tue 18 Aug 14:00-14:30 PT. Please confirm which works for you and procurement.
- I'll attach the DPA and a short roadmap slide (SOC2 milestones + ISO plan) to the follow-up.

Quick notes on FedRAMP: we do not currently hold a FedRAMP authorization. We are evaluating FedRAMP feasibility for select customers and can share the initial scoping document on the call. It would be helpful to understand which FinCo workloads might need that level of compliance so we can scope properly.
